description_en: Tests the network connectivity between a data source and a resource group
description_zh: 测试目标数据源与所使用资源组的网络连通性
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public test-network-connection --project-id 100001 --datasource-name mysql_name --env-type 1 --resource-group S_res_group_2XXXX4_1619100XXXXX --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TestNetworkConnection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the data source belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据源所在的DataWorks工作空间ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source
parameters.name: datasource_name

parameters.help_en:
The environment in which the data source resides. Valid values:

0: development environment
1: production environment
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源所属的环境。取值如下：
0：开发环境。
1：生产环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the resource group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html operation to query the identifier of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据源所使用的资源组的标识（Identifier）。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html接口获取资源组的标识（Identifier）
parameters.name: resource_group

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can locate logs and troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。用于出现错误后定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败

TaskList.description_en: The information about the connectivity test
TaskList.description_zh: 测试数据源与资源组网络连通性的返回结果

ConnectMessage.description_en: The reason why the data source and resource group failed the connectivity test. If data source and the resource group passed the connectivity test, this parameter is left empty
ConnectMessage.description_zh: 测试目标数据源与其所使用资源组的网络连通性失败后的原因描述。如果数据源与资源组网络连通性测试成功，则该参数的返回值为空

ConnectStatus.description_en:
The result of the connectivity test. Valid values:

true: The data source and the resource group passed the connectivity test.
false: The data source and the resource group failed the connectivity test. You can troubleshoot issues based on the ConnectMessage parameter
ConnectStatus.description_zh:
测试目标数据源与其所使用资源组网络连通性的结果状态。取值如下：
true：表示目标数据源与其所使用资源组的网络连通成功。
false：表示目标数据源与其所使用资源组的网络连通失败。您可以查看ConnectMessage参数定位失败原因
